## Summary

Explain the workflow problem, the proposed change, and why it belongs in the
public OrbitPage n8n package.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] The node was exercised in a local n8n instance when UI behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation and generated operation references match the implementation.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Existing workflow parameters and credentials remain compatible, or the
      migration is documented.
- [ ] Publishing, deletion, billing, email, and other side effects are explicit
      in the node UI.
- [ ] No API tokens, private endpoints, customer data, or internal SaaS details
      are included.

## Related work

Link the issue or discussion and note any intentionally deferred work.
